properties.quote: A mile N. 49 ° E. of the Montgomery-Shoshone shaft there is a group of prominent rock outcrops 800 feet long and 100 feet wide, which trends N. 30 ° E.

source.doc: USGS Bulletin 407, Geology and Ore Deposits of the Bullfrog District, Nevada (Ransome, Emmons & Garrey, 1910), p. 91
